title: Federal Buyout Decision Analyzer
description: Model the net financial value of accepting a federal Deferred Resignation / VERA/VSIP buyout offer vs. staying: compare lump sum, annuity, benefits continuation, and re-employment probability.
data_vintage: 2026 — FERS TSP contribution limits $23,500 (IRA-50+ catch-up $7,500); FEHB continuation rules; VERA/VSIP program structure
regulatory_citations: 5 U.S.C. §8336 / §8412 — CSRS/FERS voluntary early retirement authority (VERA)
5 U.S.C. §3522 — Voluntary separation incentive pay (VSIP) cap $25,000
FEHB: 5 U.S.C. §8905a — Temporary continuation of coverage (TCC) up to 18 months at 102%
FERS annuity: 1% × high-3 average salary × years of service (1.1% if 62+/20yr)

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_federal_buyout_decision
mcp_tool_definition.description: Model the financial value of accepting a federal buyout (VERA/VSIP or deferred resignation) vs. staying, comparing annuity NPV, VSIP lump sum, FEHB continuation cost, and opportunity cost of foregone salary.
